requirements.constraint_text: First Data determines eligibility before account information update request

requirements.statement: Merchants using Real Time Account Updater should refer to Account Number (Data Element 2) and Card Discretionary Block Data (Data Element 12).
requirements.expected_behavior: Reference Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data fields
requirements.constraint_text: Reference Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data fields

requirements.statement: Estimated or initial authorization must be included when the final amount is unknown, for permitted merchants (MCC 4121, 5411, 5552).
requirements.condition_trigger: MCC 4121, 5411, or 5552 and final amount unknown
requirements.expected_behavior: Estimated or initial authorization must be included in request
requirements.constraint_text: Estimated or initial authorization must be included in request

requirements.statement: Incremental authorization requests must only follow an estimated/initial authorization.
requirements.expected_behavior: Must follow an estimated or initial authorization
requirements.constraint_text: Must follow an estimated or initial authorization

requirements.statement: Incremental authorization request must contain the same Sequence Number as the estimated or initial transaction request.
requirements.expected_behavior: Sequence Number must match estimated/initial transaction request
requirements.constraint_text: Sequence Number must match estimated/initial transaction request

requirements.statement: Incremental authorization request must contain the same Transaction Identifier in Segment as the estimated or initial transaction request.
requirements.expected_behavior: Transaction Identifier must match estimated/initial transaction request
requirements.constraint_text: Transaction Identifier must match estimated/initial transaction request

requirements.statement: Incremental authorization request must contain same Terminal transaction number (Table ID 63 in Segment 111) as estimated/initial request.
requirements.expected_behavior: Terminal transaction number (Table ID 63, Segment 111) must match
requirements.constraint_text: Terminal transaction number (Table ID 63, Segment 111) must match

requirements.statement: BUYPASS Host identifies incremental authorization transactions by the approval code returned in Authorization Identification Response.
requirements.expected_behavior: Approval code returned identifies incremental transaction
requirements.constraint_text: Approval code returned identifies incremental transaction

requirements.statement: Subsequent incremental transactions must not carry the estimated authorization indicator in Sub Table ID 09.
requirements.expected_behavior: Estimated authorization indicator (Sub Table ID 09) must not be present
requirements.constraint_text: Estimated authorization indicator (Sub Table ID 09) must not be present

requirements.statement: Merchants must send the final amount in the completion transaction message.
requirements.expected_behavior: Final amount must be sent
requirements.constraint_text: Final amount must be sent

requirements.statement: For cruise lines, lodging, and car/vehicle rental merchants, approval expires 14 days after the initial estimated authorization.
requirements.condition_trigger: Cruise line, lodging, or car/vehicle rental merchant
requirements.expected_behavior: Approval response expires 14 days after initial estimated authorization
requirements.constraint_text: Approval response expires 14 days after initial estimated authorization

requirements.statement: For other rental merchants (trailer parks, campgrounds), approval expires seven days after the initial estimated authorization.
requirements.condition_trigger: Trailer park or campground rental merchant
requirements.expected_behavior: Approval response expires 7 days after initial estimated authorization
requirements.constraint_text: Approval response expires 7 days after initial estimated authorization

requirements.statement: Merchants exceeding the 14/7 day period are subject to chargebacks unless completing first transaction and initiating second on/before day 14 or 7.
requirements.expected_behavior: Subject to chargeback unless first transaction completed and second initiated within period
requirements.constraint_text: Subject to chargeback unless first transaction completed and second initiated within period

requirements.statement: DUKPT Derivation Key (DKey): Key comprised of two 16-hex halves used to generate unique PIN encryption keys per transaction.
Key Sequence Number (KSN): 20-byte HEX field used with DKey in DUKPT algorithm to derive PIN encryption keys.
Initial Key Sequence Number (IKSN): Initial KSN used with DKey to create base PIN encryption key.
Test Key: Key used for certifications, with clear key components given to customer/vendor for PIN pad injection.
Encrypted PIN Block: Constructed from combination of entered PIN and PAN fields, 4-12 digits long.
PIN Field: Structured field with control, length, entered PIN, pad digits, and reserved position.
PAN Field: Constructed from control field and right-most 12 digits of Track 2 data excluding check digit.
Card Label: Displayed at device with number of transactions and total dollar amount per category.
Partial Approval Indicator: Referenced via Partial Approval requirements applying to Signature Debit card.
eWIC Dollar Amount: Total dollar amount field added for eWIC processing in Totals Response.
eWIC Count: Count field added for eWIC processing in Totals Response.
Card Label Code: EWIC: Card Label Code value EWIC added for eWIC totals processing.
WIC Discount Amount: New eWIC data element within EBT Data Segment.
WIC Product Data: New eWIC data element containing subelement for benefit expiration date.
NFC Payment Tokenization Data Segment: Required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data, applies to NFC only.
CAVV Revised Format: Applies to Visa only; identifies Verified By Visa Format; ATN replaces XID for tokenization.
Token Requestor ID: Identifies merchant's Token Requestor ID.
Token PAN Suffix: Identifies the 4 digits of cardholder PAN to print on transaction receipt.
Cryptogram Token Data: Specific to In App transactions; represents merchant's cryptogram token data block A (or A and B).
Variable Information Indicator: New Sub-Table '06' added under POS Additional Data Information for NFC tokenization support.
Message Format Version Identifier: Identifies the message format version.
Number of Segments: Number of BUYPASS-defined segments in message; fixed value of 1.
Proprietary Data Load Segment: Indicates that this is a Proprietary Data Load Request.
Reserved: Found only in the segment-transaction matrix (page 216); no matching Chapter 12 segment-definition heading located in raw/pdf_pages.
Reserved: Found only in the segment-transaction matrix (page 216); no matching Chapter 12 segment-definition heading located in raw/pdf_pages.
Local Date and Local Time: Identifies the local date and local time of the preauthorized transaction.
Partial Approval Indicator: Indicates whether or not a merchant supports credit/debit Partial Approvals.
Fleet Data Segment: Fleet Data Segment appears in Data Section No. 3, max 61 alphanumeric chars, originates at device.
Fleet Tag 1: Sent only in Auth Completion message; tag 3 bytes fixed, data up to 31 bytes.
Fleet Tag 2: Sent only in Auth Completion message; tag 3 bytes fixed, data up to 31 bytes.
Fleet Tag 3: Sent only in Auth Completion message; tag 3 bytes fixed, data up to 31 bytes.
Fleet Tag 4: Sent only in Auth Completion message; tag 3 bytes fixed, data up to 31 bytes.
Fleet Tag 5: Sent only in Auth Completion message; tag 3 bytes fixed, data up to 31 bytes.
Customer Data: Identifies the Customer Data, sourced from Device.
User ID: Identifies the User ID, sourced from Device.
Vehicle ID#: Identifies the Vehicle ID#, sourced from Device.
Product Code Data Segment: Segment for product code data, mutually exclusive with segment 157, originates at device.
EBT Data Segment: Data segment appearing in Data Section No. 3, originates at the device.

Block Number: Identifies specific block number sent by device or host; echoed in subsequent block request.

Start Time: Indicates the time to begin using the host discount data.

Totals with Proprietary Data Load Data Segment: Segment 119 requests totals and provides current Card Table Version and Host Discount data.
Card Label: Identifies the card type, sourced from device.
Card Type Total Count: Identifies the transaction count for a particular card type.
Card Type Total Amount: Identifies the total amount for a particular card type.
Print Data 2 Segment: Sent on Financial Transaction Response messages requiring large amounts of print data.
Cryptogram Token Data: Identifies Merchant's Cryptogram Token data Block A (or block A and B); source Device.
SafeKey Data: Identifies SafeKey cryptogram indicator, AEVV and AESK transaction identifier fields; source Device.

EMV Additional Information: Identifies the EMV additional information; source Host.
CA Public Key File Segment: Data Segment No. 132 with maximum length of 77 alphanumeric characters.
Transaction Attributes Data Segment: Originates at BUYPASS; max length 19 alphanumeric characters; fields not separated by field separators.
Moneris Day End Batch Balance Segment Format (Response): Reiterates first 6 request fields, adds Moneris text response and total debit transactions for batch.
Number of Credits: Number of credit transactions in this batch, sourced from device.
Credit Dollar Value: Dollar value of all credit transactions in batch, format +/-9(16)v99.
Number of Corrections: Number of correction transactions in this batch, sourced from device.
Corrections Dollar Value: Dollar value of all correction transactions in batch, format +/-9(16)v99.
Table ID: Fixed value 001 identifying Enhanced Fleet Request Flags sub-segment.

Table ID: Fixed value 002 identifying non-fuel product data table.

Product Category: Identifies product category from PRODUCTS table or default MERC.

Table ID: Fixed value 004 identifying Prompt Data table.

Prompt: Identifies a prompt to which the terminal is responding.

Prompt Response: Value entered in response to a prompt token.

Trip Number (TRIP): EMV tag DF22, Trip Number prompt token, max length 10.
Extended Driver ID (EXID): EMV tag DF23, Extended Driver ID prompt token, max length 20.
Unit ID (UNIT): EMV tag DF24, Unit ID prompt token, max length 10.
Contract/PO (PONB): EMV tag DF25, Contract/PO prompt token, max length 10.
Driver License (DLIC): EMV tag DF26, Driver License prompt token, max length 20.
Voyager Data (DF32-DF6F reserved tags): Reserved future-use EMV tags DF32-DF6F, prompt token matches EMV tag directly.
Additional Prompted Data 1: Visa Fleet EMV 2.0 prompt token AD1 for additional prompted data.
Additional Prompted Data 2: Visa Fleet EMV 2.0 prompt token AD2 for additional prompted data.
Driver ID: Visa Fleet EMV 2.0 prompt token DRI for Driver ID, mutually exclusive with GEN/VHI.
Employee Number: Visa Fleet EMV 2.0 prompt token EMP for Employee Number.
Generic ID: Visa Fleet EMV 2.0 prompt token GEN for Generic ID, mutually exclusive with DRI/VHI.
Odometer (Visa Fleet EMV 2.0 prompt): Visa Fleet EMV 2.0 prompt token ODM for Odometer.
Trailer Number: Visa Fleet EMV 2.0 prompt token TRL for Trailer Number.
Vehicle ID: Visa Fleet EMV 2.0 prompt token VHI for Vehicle ID, mutually exclusive with GEN/DRI.
Work Order Number: Visa Fleet EMV 2.0 prompt token WON for Work Order Number.
Table ID: Table ID field for Money Code Payee Name layout, fixed value 006.
Payee Name (Table Data): Payee Name formatted 'Last Name,First Initial', optional for Money Code transactions.
Money Code Check Number: Money Code check number, required for all Money Code transactions.
Cash Advance Limit: Maximum dollar amount host should return for cash advance limit, with decimal point.
Table ID (Enhanced Fleet Response Flags): Fixed value 001 identifying the Enhanced Fleet Response Flags table.
Table Length (Enhanced Fleet Response Flags): Variable value, max 020, indicating length of table data.
Table Data (Enhanced Fleet Response Flags): Series of comma-separated flags for data between EFS authorizer and POS.
Table ID (Non-fuel Product Limits): Fixed value 002 identifying non-fuel product limits table.
Table Length (Non-fuel Product Limits): Variable length, max 350, of product limits data including separators.
Table Data (Non-fuel Product Limits): Product limits data formatted with product category, colon, amount, and separators.
Product Category: Identifies allowed product category corresponding to Dynamic Card Table PRODUCTS table.
Colon: Colon separates product category from associated data.
Amount: Amount of product category allowed, sum of products should not exceed this amount.
Table ID (Fuel Product Limits): Fixed value 003 identifying fuel product limits table.
Table Length (Fuel Product Limits): Variable length, max 350, of fuel product limits including separators.
Table Data (Fuel Product Limits): Fuel product limits formatted per subsequent element list.
Product Code: Identifies a product using standard product codes from ATL105 Appendix F.
Total Price: Total currency allowed for this product, decimal point included.
Table ID: Fixed value 004, identifies Prompt Formats response table.
Table Length: Variable value max 200, overall length of all prompt formats including separators.
Table Data: Prompt Formats data, formatted with prompt and format pairs.
Prompt: Identifies a prompt to which the terminal should respond.
Prompt Format: Prompt format using edit masks separated by semicolons.
Table ID: Fixed value identifying Customer Information (005) or Additional Response Data (010) table.
Table Length: Variable length value, max 070 or max 200 depending on table.
Table Data: Customer info or Additional Response data formatted per table specification.
Data Label: Identifies type of data being returned in Additional Response Data table.
Data Value: Data being returned, length varies by Data Label value.
FNAM (Cardholder's First Name): Data Label value for Cardholder's First Name, max 15 chars.
LNAM (Cardholder's Last Name): Data Label value for Cardholder's Last Name, max 20 chars.
ATHN (Transaction's Auth Number): Data Label value for transaction's Auth Number, differs from Approval Code.
ACCT (Account Code): Data Label value for Account Code on Express Check Encashment Response.
DMSG (Driver Message): Data Label value for Driver Message, max 80 chars.
Available Product Information: All available product information from WEX, sourced from host.
Restriction Code: 2-digit fuel product group code limiting which products can be added.
Restriction Code amount: Fuel amount limit applied to restriction code if code length is 2.
Restriction Code Quantity: Fuel quantity limit applied to restriction code if code length is 2.
Restriction Code Unit of Measure: Unit of measure for the Restriction Code Quantity.
Fuel Price Update Request Segment: Data Segment No.149 contains data required by the Comdata authorizer for fuel price updates.
Market Basket Data: Describes market basket data for current OTC transaction; one DV dataset plus up to 10 PI datasets.
Market Basket Data: Describes market basket data; consists of 1 DV dataset, up to 10 PI and 10 PU datasets.
Table ID: Sub-segment tag with fixed value 001 for Network Token sub-segment.
Table Length: Length of Network Token sub-segment data, value 013-018.
Table Data: Contains Network Token Data such as expiration date.
Network Token Expiration Date: Table Data field holding the Network Token Expiration Date with fixed table ID 002.
Network Token Provisional Fee Indicator: Table Data field for Network Token Provisional Fee Indicator with fixed table ID 003.
Network Token Input Indicator: Table Data field for Network Token Input Indicator with fixed table ID 004.
Network Token Eligible Indicator: Table Data field for Network Token Eligible Indicator with fixed table ID 005.
Network Token PAN Indicator: Named as a Network Token Data Layout entry but no attribute table given on this page.
Real Time Account Updater Response Data Segment: Sent only when transaction qualifies for and uses First Data Auth Optimizer service.
Account Updater Card Number: Sub-table containing new account number info from First Data Auth Optimizer service.
Account Updater TransArmor Token: Sub-table for TransArmor token account updater data, Table ID fixed value 002.
Account Updater Card Number (Table Data an19): Included only when merchant sent Account Updater Request Indicator = Y; applicable to Visa/MasterCard only.
Account Updater Expiration Date: New expiration date (YYMM) from First Data Auth Optimizer, applicable to Visa/MasterCard only.
Account Updater Card Status: Account status code from First Data Auth Optimizer (A/E/Q/C/U), Visa/MasterCard only.
Original Association Response Code: Original decline code from Authorizing Network when First Data performs Auth Optimization.
Account Updater Result Code: Table entry defining Account Updater Result Code fields, continues onto next page.
Real Time Account Updater Result Code: Result code received from Network or Card Issuer Auth Optimization request.
EV Charging Data Segment: Data Segment No. 156, sent for an EV charging transaction, applicable to Visa card type only.
Table ID (EV Transaction Indicator): Sub-field of EV Charging Data with fixed value 01, identifying EV Transaction Indicator table.
Table Length (EV Transaction Indicator): Sub-field of EV Charging Data with fixed value 001.
Table Data (EV Transaction Indicator): 'Y' indicates EV charging data present; mandatory for EV transaction.
Total Time Plugged In: Total time vehicle was plugged in, format hhmmss, Table ID 02.
Total Charging Time: Actual time taken to charge the vehicle, format hhmmss, Table ID 03.
Start Time of Charge: Start time of charge in local time of card acceptor location, format hhmmss, Table ID 04.
Finish Time of Charge (Table ID 05): Finish time of charge in local time, format hhmmss.
Charging Power Output Capacity (Table ID 06): Charging station power output capacity in kW, max length 6.
Charging Reason Code (Table ID 07): Charging reason code for transaction, max length 3.
Table ID (Estimated KM/Miles Added): Fixed value 08 identifying the Estimated KM/Miles Added table.
Table Length (Estimated KM/Miles Added): Variable length field ranging 001-006 for the Estimated KM/Miles Added table.
Table Data (Estimated KM/Miles Added): Estimate of total distance added in km/miles based on kWh and vehicle engine type.
Carbon Footprint: Carbon footprint avoidance measurement in grams of CO2e saved for the purchase.
Estimated Vehicles KM/Miles Available: Estimated mileage the car will have after completion of the EV charge.
Maximum Power Dispensed: Maximum power dispensed during a specific EV charge session at the station.
Connector Type: Connector Type field, Table ID fixed value 12, variable length 001-003.
Adjusted Product Code Data Segment: Segment for Comdata fleet fuel/product data, exclusive of Product Code Data Segment.
Merchant Data Segment: Data Segment No. DL1, max 399 alphanumeric characters, originates at BUYPASS.
Card Type: Identifies the card type accepted by the transmitting device.
End-of-Data Indicator: Indicates the end of the data segment; fixed value ~.
Dial String Data Segment: Dial String Data Segment, max length 69 alphanumeric characters, originates at BUYPASS.
Dial String Terminator: Indicates end of second dial string, fixed value F, sourced from Host.
End-of-Data Indicator: Indicates end of data segment, fixed value ~, sourced from Host.
Secondary Phone Number: Identical to Primary Phone Number info except phone number; used after primary attempts exhausted.
Date and Time Data Segment: Segment DL3 conveys BUYPASS day of week, date, and time; originates at BUYPASS.
Software Dial Load Data Segment: Downloads an application from a device management system supported by BUYPASS.
Software IP Load Data Segment: Used to download an application from a BUYPASS-supported device management system.
Store and Forward Data Segment: Max 9 alphanumeric chars, originates at BUYPASS, defines store and forward blocking times.
Download Data: All or some Download Data in tag/len/data format per Appendix W.
EMV Terminal Floor Limits Data Segment: Contains floor limits per card type (RID) for a terminal, included based on terminal-level special.
Data Type Indicator: Indicates EMV Floor Limits data, fixed value '%'.
Segment Length: Indicates data segment length, exclusive of Data Type Indicator.
RID: EMV Application Identifier, repeated per RID up to 24 times.
Stand-in Indicator: Stand-in Indicator sourced from Host.
Floor Limit: Maximum allowable stand-in value.
BUYPASS RID Card Type: BUYPASS card type associated with this RID.
MICR Data: MICR Data has a maximum length of 50 bytes, found in Check Data Segment.
Access Code: Identifies data dialed prior to phone number in Telephone Table Load Response.
Account Number: Account Number field with variable max length depending on TransArmor mode and message direction.
Account Number: Identifies the card or account; variable length in request, fixed length in response.
Card Discretionary Block Data: Data read from card after the = character when using Track 2 reader.
Address Line 1: Identifies the street address of the transmitting device location.
Address Line 2: Identifies city, state, and ZIP Code/ZIP+4 of transmitting device location; used in Merchant Data Segment.
Approval Number: Fixed 6-char alphanumeric code identifying the assigned approval number.
Approved Amount: Fixed 9-digit zero-filled amount approved by the issuer with two decimal places.
Authorizer Code: Fixed length two-digit numeric code identifying the authorizer, defined by BUYPASS.
Authorizer Response Code: Two alphanumeric, space-filled characters identifying the response type from the authorizer.
Block Number: Identifies specific proprietary or public key data block requested by device or sent by host.
Card Discretionary Block Data: Identifies the card's expiration date and/or discretionary data.
Card Label: Fixed length four alphanumeric chars, left-aligned space-filled, identifies card type in Totals Response.
Card Type: Identifies card type, feature, or requested data type depending on transaction context.
Card Type Total Amount: Fixed length eight-digit field with two assumed decimals for total amount per card type.
Card Type Total Count: Fixed 5-digit field identifying transaction count for a card type in Totals Response.
Cash Amount: Variable up to 8 digits with two decimal places, identifies cash back amount.
Clerk ID: Variable up to 10 digits identifying clerk's identification number.
Currency Code: Fixed length three digit code identifying currency type by country.
Current Date: Fixed length six digit date field (MMDDYY) originating at BUYPASS.
Current Time: Identifies the current time, fixed length HHMM, N type.
Cut Time: Identifies merchant's end-of-day settlement time, fixed length HHMM.
Data Type Indicator: Identifies specific characteristics of following data in a host response; required for TransArmor and EMV CA Public Key File Load.
Day of the Week: Identifies the current day of the week, originates at BUYPASS.
Day of the Week: Codes 0-6 represent Sunday through Saturday.
Decline Code: Two alphanumeric characters identifying the reason for decline.
Dial String Terminator: One alphanumeric character indicating end of a dial string.
Dial String Type: Indicates transaction dial strings, fixed value 1.
Direct Marketing Invoice Number: Identifies the invoice number in a Direct Marketing/Address Verification System Request.
Download Indicator: Indicates whether the device should request a load and what type.
Driver/Identification Number: Unencrypted Driver/Identification Number for fleet cards requiring it.
Employee Number: Identifies the employee who performs a utility transaction, for reporting only.
Encrypted PIN Block Data: AN field; DUKPT KSN plus 16-byte PIN block for encrypted PIN data.
End-of-Data Indicator: Fixed one alpha character indicating end of a data segment.
End-of-Load Indicator: Fixed one alpha character indicating the end of a Table Load, used in Table Load Response.
Extract Date: Fixed six digit date (MMDDYY) identifying when info was extracted for Electronic Mail Data Segment.
Extract Time: Identifies the time information was extracted for an Electronic Mail Data Segment, format HHMM.
Fee Amount: Identifies the fee amount calculated by BUYPASS, 8 digits with two decimal places.
Firmware Version: Identifies the device's firmware version at the customer location.
Fleet Employee Number: Variable length up to 10 digits used for fleet cards requiring a fleet employee number.
Fuel Purchase Amount: Total dollar amount of fuel sold for the transaction, up to 8 digits with two decimal places.
Initiation Date: Local date transaction performed, fixed 6 digits MMDDYY, calculated by BUYPASS system clock.
Initiation Time: Local time transaction performed, fixed 4 digits HHMM, calculated by BUYPASS system clock.
Job Number: Variable length up to 10 digits identifying the Job Number.
Load Type: Identifies load type; indicates key or CA Public Key File info requested.
Local Date and Local Time: Identifies local date (MMDDYY) and local time (HHMM) of preauthorized transaction.
Merchant Name: Fixed length up to 24 alphanumeric characters identifying merchant at transmitting device location.
Merchant Phone Number: Fixed length 13 alphanumeric characters identifying telephone number of transmitting device location.
Message Format Version Identifier: Fixed 6-character alphanumeric field identifying message format type and release version.
Net Amount: Difference between Grand Total and Fee Amount in a Totals Response.
New Software Version: Identifies the new software application version number, fixed length 8 alphanumeric characters.
Nonfuel Amount: Dollar amount of transaction not fuel, tax, or cash; max 8 bytes for Amex, 7 otherwise.
Number of Card Types: Identifies number of times Field 8 repeats in Merchant Data Segment.
Number of Print Lines: Indicates number of times Terminal Display/Printer Message appears in response.
Number of Products: Identifies count of products reported for a transaction.
Odometer: Identifies odometer reading keyed in by customer or clerk; variable length one to eight digits.
Password: Identifies password entered during end-of-day function, matched against merchant profile.
Pause Indicator: Indicates device should pause about one second before proceeding, for slow dial tones.
PC Duty Amount: Identifies the duty amount in a Purchase Card Transaction Request.
PC Freight Amount: Identifies freight charges included in Direct Marketing/Address Verification System Request.
PC Tax Amount: Identifies the transaction tax amount in Purchase Card Data Segment (104).
Phone Number: Identifies primary, secondary, or tertiary phone number used in transaction dialing.
Product Amount: Monetary value of product purchased in Product Code or Adjusted Product Code Data Segment.
Product Code: Identifies product type in Data Segment 102 or 157, N type, fixed 3 digits.
Prompt Code: AN type, variable length 3-4 chars, identifies transaction type and card type.
Pump/Lane Number: Identifies the pump or lane number at the point-of-sale location.
Redial Count: Identifies number of times subsequent phone number in DL2 segment can be redialed.
Response Code: Identifies approval/decline status varying by transaction type (financial, totals, mail, EMV, TransArmor).
Response Code: Last element in message if TransArmor Key Load request is declined.
Segment Length: Identifies the length of the segment in which it appears; calculated from element lengths and delimiters.
Segment Type: Identifies segment type in Financial, Totals, Loyalty, Email, or TransArmor requests.
Sequence Number: Fixed six-digit number identifying a transaction for its entire life, included on all transaction types.
Service Level: Identifies sale type for a product in Product Code or Adjusted Product Code Data Segment.
Ship-from Postal Code: Identifies postal code of shipping location, fixed nine digits plus hyphen.
Ship-to Country Code: Identifies postal code of country to which shipment is sent, three digits.
Ship-to Postal Code: Identifies the postal code of the location to which a shipment is sent.
Software Load Phone Number: Identifies telephone number associated with the device management system.
Software Load Request Date: Identifies date device will request full load of new application.
Software Load Request Time: Identifies the time the device will request a full load of new application, fixed HHMM.
Software Load Type: Identifies the type of software the device will request from the device management system.
Software Terminal Record ID: Identifies the Software Terminal Record ID for the device management system.
Software Version: Identifies the device's software version at the customer location.
Start-of-Data Block Indicator: Indicates the start of a data block in a Table Load Response.
Terminal Display /Printer Message: Fixed 31 alphanumeric characters, space-filled, identifies a device or printer message for merchant.
Totals Date: Identifies date for which totals or totals and end-of-day are requested.
Unit of Measure: Identifies measurement type for a product in Product Code Data Segment.
Unit Price: Identifies price per Unit of Measure of a product; variable length up to nine digits.
Vehicle Number: Identifies the Vehicle Number, found in Fleet Data Segment if required by issuer.
Voucher ID: Identifies the preprinted voucher used in a local approval transaction.
Variable Information Indicator: Identifies the type of variable information in a Variable Information Data Segment.

Additional Information Data Segment Flag: Indicates whether an Additional Information Data Segment follows in the message.

Print Data: Identifies data to print at the device.

UPC/PLU data: UPC/PLU data left-padded with zeroes; first position indicates UPC (0) or PLU (1).
Item Price: Approved price for item, format 9999v99.

Number of Discounts: Provides number of host discount items that will follow.

Site Configuration Data: Alphanumeric variable-length field providing site configuration data for merchant location.
Prompt Code, Pending: 4-character alphanumeric code identifying pending requested data in special transactions.

Token Requestor ID: Identifies merchant's Token Requestor ID, left justified space-filled.

Settlement Type: Identifies whether transaction processed as single message debit or dual message credit.
Signature Required: Indicates if a signature is required for this transaction.
Receipt Card Description: Text used on printed receipt to indicate card type.
Fuel Volume Data: Provides the fuel volume data for merchant location.
Cryptogram Token Data: Identifies cryptogram token data blocks A and B from merchant for tokenization transactions.

Load Subtype: Identifies the load subtype as Moneris, fixed length 1 byte AN.

Number of Corrections: Indicates number of correction transactions in a batch, fixed 4-byte numeric.
Corrections Dollar Value: Fixed 19-byte AN field with sign and two implied decimals for corrections total.

Download Data: Identifies all or some of the Download Data, alphanumeric variable length.
RID: Identifies EMV application via a valid Registered Application Provider identifier.
Stand-in Indicator: Indicates the stand-in processing indicator for the transaction.

Variable Information Length: Identifies length of the content of Variable Information.
